name: Red Priest
intro: The Red Priest pathway specializes in war, fire, provocation and large-scale destruction. It grows stronger as battle becomes more chaotic and dangerous.

meter.name: War Momentum
meter.full: An allied follow-up strikes the focused enemy

ability.name: Hunter's Instinct
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Hunter's Instinct — +10% Initiative; +10 percentage points accuracy. Passive.

ability.name: Provocation
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Provocation — Enemy DEF −20% for 2 turns; Redirects enemy target selection to you for 2 turns, unless taunt-immune; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 15 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Fireball Barrage
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Fireball Barrage — Deals 140% ATK + 35% INT Fire damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 25 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Reaper's Harvest
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Reaper's Harvest — Deals 170% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Physical damage (22% base DEF bypass); +25 percentage points critical chance on this cast; +25 percentage points critical damage on this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Iron Blood Vigor
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Iron Blood Vigor — +15% Max HP; +15% DEF. Passive.

ability.name: Iron Blood Steel Body
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Iron Blood Steel Body — +30% DEF for 2 turns; Stores +180% damage for your next landed damaging-skill hit; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: War Command
ability.label: Active
ability.description: War Command — Supports all living allies; +25% ATK for 2 turns; +25% SPEED for 2 turns; At 100 charge, ready one allied follow-up per living ally, at 50% of the commander's ATK, for 2 turns.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 65 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Weather Storm
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Weather Storm — Targets all enemies; Deals 270% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Fire damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Conqueror's March
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Conqueror's March — Deals 320% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Fire damage (22% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Stunned (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: War Flame Cataclysm
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: War Flame Cataclysm — Deals 420% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 125 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
